summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare IP
details: @drone-js-ext/core@2.0.1 ships a beacon script (beacon.cjs) that POSTs installer host identifiers — os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded plain-HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires at install time via a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and again on require() through index.js, which re-invokes the beacon and exports a Proxy whose property access returns no-op functions so importers appear to succeed. The package provides no real functionality beyond this beacon; the self-described 'Compatibility shim' framing and the @drone-js-ext/core scope match a dependency-confusion / typosquat reconnaissance callback pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
